summary: Enhance your skills with our Lean Project Management Training Course. Learn efficient techniques to streamline processes and boost productivity.
lede: Lean project management helps project professionals improve workflows, reduce waste and focus project work on value. Designed for project managers, team leaders and operations professionals, the course covers waste identification, value stream mapping and Kanban, as well as lean planning and resource management. You’ll also learn to track performance with metrics, engage stakeholders and support continuous improvement.
audienceIntro: Lean Project Management is for professionals ready to elevate their project outcomes. This course is perfect for:
audience: Operations managers eager to optimize processes
